title: Categorize page: 'Leave uncategorized' is never sent on a timer; rows stay in a Leaving strip until the user presses Done or leaves the page
description: Owner decision 2026-11-25 (Categorize Inbox thread): 'Never send it on a timer'. Today a skip is sent when its own 10 s timer ends. New behaviour: pressing S (or the button) moves the row to a 'Leaving uncategorized' strip, with no countdown; each row there has Undo, and Z still pops the undo stack in key-press order. Nothing is sent until the user presses a 'Done' button on the strip (which names how many rows will leave the list for everyone in the budget), or leaves the page / switches budget / closes the tab, at which point the pending rows ARE sent (the reverse of today, where leaving cancels them): confirm on in-app navigation with a short prompt naming the count (Send and leave / Keep them and leave / Stay); on tab close use the best effort the platform allows and say what it is. Accept bundle / Accept all keep excluding rows in the strip. Also fix from review-mjug-4.md follow-ups 1, 2 and 5: no empty '0 transactions' undo entry; bundle, Accept all and header counts exclude rows in the strip; and with no timer the late-Z race disappears. Keep the app running on :3100/:8091 from the task's worktree for the owner.
notes:
Skips never go out on a timer: Leaving strip (no countdown, Undo per row, Done button naming the count, hint says tab close/reload sends nothing), Z in key-press order, leave prompt (Send and leave / Keep them and leave / Stay) on route or budget change, browser leave-site question while rows wait. Counts (header, bundles, Accept all) exclude strip rows; Accept bundle/all exclude them; empty bundle accept leaves no undo entry; all skip-timer code removed. Finding: the rail Link does a FULL PAGE LOAD in the browser (window state lost), so rail navigation cannot be intercepted by the prompt (rows just come back); router.push navigation and budget switch are covered. client: tsc 0, eslint 0, bun test 1465 pass 0 fail.
Round 2: Done/Send-and-leave lock the rows first (no Undo, Z passes over, shows 'being sent'), re-check before each request, busy counter balanced; leave prompt locked while sending, names the budget, shows sent/failed counts; retry rows stay in the strip, refused rows leave with a note; strip rows dropped only when the queue page is the whole queue; badge excludes the strip; hint reworded. client: tsc 0, eslint 0, bun test 1474 pass 0 fail.
Round 3: rows committed by Done are not offered to the leave prompt, never restored locked, and finish sending after the page goes away; Z never passes over sending rows (shows 'being sent'); 400/403/404 leave with a note; dropped note in the prompt; pt-BR plurals. Verified with a 3-5 s delayed /categorize/skip: Done then switch + Stay/Keep/Send, Done then route change, Z during send. client: tsc 0, eslint 0, bun test 1474 pass 0 fail.
